newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 6.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:

* PrimeStar Partners and News Corp Ltd are expected to announce early next week that they have formed a satellite TV alliance, clearing the way for News Corp to also announce a $1.8 billion acquisition of International Family Entertainment Inc.
* Actor Sylvester Stallone is close to signing a deal that would reunite him with director Renny Harlin on "Frequency," by Time Warner Inc 's New Line Cinema.
* Robert Stigwood, the veteran showbiz impresario behind such hits as Jesus Christ Superstar and Saturday Night Fever, has been named nonexecutive chairman of Galaxy Media Corp.
* MK Productions has acquired Lance Hill's speculative script "The Way It Ends," which delves into a computer surveillance spy who falls in love with the wife of a global arms dealer.
* Twentieth Century Fox has acquired a thriller with the working title "Creole," by actress-writer Jada Pinkett.
* Fox Searchlight has signed a deal with British playwright Harold Pinter to adapt Isak Dinesen's short story "The Dreaming Child" for Julia Ormond to produce and possibly to star.
